edges.why: Decision step 2: the collection is Terra MODIS Level 2 aerosol data (MOD04_L2 granules, "MODO4" in the file names) subset to the CLAMS period and region; PARENT. Generic "MODIS aerosol data products" mapped to MOD04_L2 by instrument (MODIS), platform (Terra) and level (L2). The 2001 subset predates Collection 6.1, the only MOD04_L2 version in CMR.
